text:
Three statements about synthetic polymers are listed.
1
Man-made fibres are used for making clothing.
2
Plastics can cause pollution problems both on land and at sea.
3
Plastics which do not rot away are described as non-biodegradable.
Which statements are correct?
A
1 and 2 only
B
1 and 3 only
C
2 and 3 only
D
1, 2 and 3
subject: Chemistry
